project_type: Laravel 11 backend (PHP 8.1+) + React 18 SPA frontend with Vite 5
build_system: Composer for Laravel, npm for React frontend. Docker Compose orchestrates both services.
test_framework: PHPUnit for backend (tests/Feature, tests/Unit), Vitest for frontend
build_command: docker compose up for full stack; npm run build for frontend production build; composer install for backend deps
test_command: npm run test for frontend unit tests; docker compose exec app php artisan test for backend tests
verification_instructions:
1. Start docker services: docker compose up -d
2. Run backend tests: docker compose exec app php artisan test --filter=User
3. Run frontend tests: npm run test
4. Manual verification: visit http://localhost:5173/admin?tab=users after logging in with manager/admin credentials
environment_constraints: Docker containers must be running for backend API access. Frontend runs mock data by default (VITE_DATA_SOURCE=mocks); set VITE_DATA_SOURCE=api to use real Laravel backend. MySQL container must be healthy before Laravel app starts.
contribution_requirements: No explicit CONTRIBUTING.md found. Follow Laravel and React best practices. Maintain existing modular architecture (app/Modules/<Module> for backend). Preserve RBAC enforcement via RoleMiddleware. Use existing BaseController response helpers (successResponse, errorResponse, paginatedResponse).
key_patterns: Backend: Controller -> Service -> Model architecture. Request classes handle validation and authorization. Resources shape API responses. BaseController provides successResponse/errorResponse/paginatedResponse helpers. Frontend: fetchData() wrapper toggles between mocks and API. API client (resources/js/shared/api/*) uses apiClient from client.js. Pages follow Card/Table/Modal component patterns.
directory_structure: Backend: app/Modules/UserManagement/{Controllers,Services,Requests,Resources,Routes}. Frontend: resources/js/{pages/admin/users, shared/{api,components,mocks}}. Tests: tests/{Feature,Unit} for backend, resources/js/**/*.test.jsx for frontend (if exists).
